verdict.rationale: Evidence shows Apify's web-scraper Actor supports a configurable page cap via maxCrawlPages (apify-docs-15) and Crawlee/Apify SDK docs reference crawling capabilities, but there is no explicit documentation of a breadth-first vs depth-first strategy toggle. missing for 10: explicit breadth-first-strategy configuration option, independent/hands-on confirmation of BFS crawl behavior with page-limit enforcement.
